# Skin Analysis Medical Spa

> Nurse-owned medical spa with two Oʻahu locations (Ewa Beach and Aiea) offering injectables, DiamondGlow facials, SkinPen microneedling, chemical peels, dermaplaning, and red light therapy. Owned and operated by Sarah Lockwood-Sepulveda, FNP-BC and Allison Sipple, RN-BSN.

## Locations

- Ewa Beach: 91-3475 Nana Hope, Ewa Beach, HI 96706 · 808-213-8383
- Aiea: 99-209 Moanalua Rd. #310, Aiea, HI 96701 · 808-979-1098
- Hours: By appointment only, Mon–Sat 8:30 am – 6:00 pm
- Cashless business · All major cards accepted

## Treatments

- [Dysport® Wrinkle Relaxer](https://www.skinanalysishi.com/treatments/dysport/): $15/unit, 30–45 min
- [DiamondGlow® Facial](https://www.skinanalysishi.com/treatments/diamondglow-facial/): starting $275, 75–90 min
- [DiamondGlow® Body](https://www.skinanalysishi.com/treatments/diamondglow-body/)
- [SkinPen Microneedling](https://www.skinanalysishi.com/treatments/skinpen-microneedling/): $500 full face, 60–75 min
- [Medical-Grade Chemical Peels](https://www.skinanalysishi.com/treatments/chemical-peels/): $175–$225, 45–60 min
- [Dermaplaning](https://www.skinanalysishi.com/treatments/dermaplaning/)
- [Red Light Therapy](https://www.skinanalysishi.com/treatments/red-light-therapy/)
- [Professional Skincare](https://www.skinanalysishi.com/treatments/professional-skincare/)
- [Complimentary Consultation](https://www.skinanalysishi.com/treatments/consultation/)
